scope: Generic exact-header semantic support for dirty inventory workbooks without broadening token-containment inference.

corrections.genericRule: Short or operationally ambiguous inventory labels are eligible only on normalized whole-header equality. They do not participate in token containment.

safetyPreserved: The frozen release-corpus candidate quality and grain totals are unchanged.
Exact-header aliases cannot create substring matches on unrelated columns.
Workbook sheets still require independent grain and readiness validation.
No SUM authorization is inferred from a header alias alone.
